title: Illumina COVIDSeq - Amplify Tagmented DNA
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the required protocol parameters in the input fields provided above.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file to your computer and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the labware definition files with .json extensions.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App Protocol tab, upload the protocol script file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck modules and labware on the robot according to the supplied deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT App to calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette; refer to the support articles for calibration guidance.

steps.title: Start run
steps.instruction: Press the Run button in the OT App to execute the protocol.
